title: The macroscopic cosmos is quantized: the solar system solves Diophantine equations

statements.text: The macroscopic vacuum does not compute continuous differential equations but resolves discrete Diophantine equations over $K$, so the architecture of the solar system is quantized, which continuous Euclidean and Newton-Kepler metrics cannot resolve.

sources.quote: the macroscopic vacuum does not compute continuous differential equations; rather, it resolves discrete Diophantine equations over the constructible Logvinovich field
